creator: Earthbound
changes: Original Blender-authored female Bornean orangutan. Custom lofted anatomical surfaces voxel-unified into a continuous body; continuous Scenario Clay head sculpt with inset eyes, painted skin/coat UV atlas, original russet directional texture, and hand-authored area-sampled draped hair cards. Original curved digits, bowed legs, long arms and grasping feet. No purchased, imported or third-party animal geometry. Phase 2.5: shorter region-specific draped groom, reduced strand contrast, shallow eyelid/nasolabial/forehead pigment detail and adjusted nasal/brow contours. Mobile uses one-triangle strands to retain half the groom within its original budget.
animationNote: Original 38-bone educational in-place Idle, four-second support/recovery Walk, five-second alternating-grasp Climb, and Reach. Climb wrists use stationary virtual reference points during support; no tree collision or traversal simulation is present. Hand-authored timing, not motion capture or expert-validated biomechanics.
